svg.title: Vision Reads Images; Generation Makes Them
svg.desc: Left, computer vision interprets an existing image: classification labels the whole image, object detection adds bounding boxes to say where, captioning describes the scene, and OCR reads text. Right, image generation starts from a text prompt: a GPT-image model creates a new image, and Sora creates video. Retired or limited: dall-e-3 was retired in March 2026, Image Analysis 4.0 is deprecated, Face emotion and gender recognition are retired, and identity features need approved Limited Access.
svg.text: Vision Reads Images; Generation Makes Them
